source_title: Office of the Registrar: Waitlisting and Swapping Classes
text: In Orion, a full class that allows waitlisting is marked Wait List. A full section marked Closed does not accept waitlisting. Joining a waitlist does not guarantee enrollment. If a seat becomes available, Orion can enroll the next eligible student automatically, subject to holds, schedule conflicts and credit-hour limits.

source_title: Office of the Registrar: Waitlisting and Swapping Classes
section_heading: Swapping an enrolled course with a waitlisted course
text: Use the swap feature to designate the enrolled course to replace if a seat becomes available in your waitlisted course. Being enrolled in a different section of the same course can block automatic registration from the waitlist unless you use swap.
